about.description: TRAHK is an ETF perpetual listed on Gate, tracking Tracker Fund of Hong Kong, margined and cash-settled in USDT. Traders get synthetic price exposure only - no ownership, dividend or voting rights in the underlying. Funding settles every 8h. Up to 20x leverage. Margin is custodied by the exchange rather than self custodied, and access requires exchange onboarding with identity verification.
